His coat must be closed over his torso, no open trench, visible belt harness, weapons, guns or code magic. Preserve this specific film identity; correct the old reference’s open coat. Empty-handed martial combination: settles in a bent-knee guard, steps forward with a straight palm strike, pivots into a controlled high side kick, draws the leg back into guard. Four distinct full-body poses; no opponents, impact burst, flying projectile, giant green explosion or body beam. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

No laser beam, distant bullet, target impact or magic kiss. Keep both pistols separate and anatomically held. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

characterAssets.name: Morpheus
